reply.text:
That is one for a doctor or physio, not a coach. Two weeks of soreness that shows up on rest days is worth getting looked at properly, and I would not guess at what it means from here.

I can keep working with you on the training side while you get it checked. If a doctor or physio clears you to train, tell me what they say and I will build around it, and I will need to know what to avoid.
